steps: Spaceship → Hosting → cPanel → SSH Access → Manage SSH Keys → generate a key and Authorize it. Copy the PRIVATE key, plus the server host name, cPanel username and home folder (shown on cPanel's right-hand panel). Also copy the two hosting nameservers (ns1…, ns2…).

Spaceship → API Manager → create a NEW API key with domain read and write access. Copy its key and secret. (You need a new one because Vercel has the existing secret locked: it is marked Sensitive and can't be shown.)

Vercel → project easypeazy-api → Settings → Environment Variables. Click the eye next to each of these and copy the value: SUPABASE_DB_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, ELEGANT_THEMES_USERNAME, ELEGANT_THEMES_API_KEY. (easypeazy-api is the right project even though its home page is plain text. It is the back end; easypeazy-web is the website and has none of these keys.)

GitHub → lincolnnunnally/easypeazy → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret. Add each under these exact names: CPANEL_SSH_KEY, CPANEL_HOST, CPANEL_USER, CPANEL_HOME, WP_HOSTING_NAMESERVERS (both, comma-separated), SPACESHIP_API_KEY, SPACESHIP_API_SECRET (the new pair from step 2), SUPABASE_DB_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, ELEGANT_THEMES_USERNAME, ELEGANT_THEMES_API_KEY.

tasks.why: Governments pay for Commons by card, bank transfer, or a net-30 invoice with a PO number. Products, prices and the webhook can be made by an agent through the Stripe connection; a secret API key cannot (Stripe only lets the account owner create one). Without it, sign-ups and the free month work, but nobody can pay.
steps: Recommended account: United Under God, Inc. (the company governments will contract with). In that account, live mode: Developers, API keys, Create restricted key, name it commons
Give it Write on: Customers, Checkout Sessions, Products, Prices, Subscriptions, Invoices, Customer portal. Leave everything else None
Paste the key (rk_live_...) to a Claude session, or add it yourself in Vercel project commons as STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (Production)
The agent then creates the webhook, sets STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and confirms /api/health shows checkout: true. The five plans are created automatically on first checkout
